verdicts.title: What each verdict means
verdicts.description: "Verified" means one specific thing here, and nothing looser.
verdicts.assistants: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini are asked about each attribute without being shown your listing's values (they do see the product name). Their answers never verify or contradict a claim; they only show where an assistant says something different.

verified.label: Verified
verified.definition: A page beyond your store and the brand's own site, which ecentic opened itself, states it. The quote is shown.

cited.label: Cited
cited.definition: Perplexity cites an outside source for it, but ecentic couldn't confirm it on the page itself.

merchantOnly.label: No outside support
merchantOnly.definition: This check found no source beyond your store and the brand's own site that states it.

contradicted.label: Contradicted
contradicted.definition: A page beyond your store and the brand's own site, which ecentic opened, states something different.

notCheckable.label: Not checkable
notCheckable.definition: Marketing as written: no measure, test or comparison anyone could check.

unresearched.label: Not researched
unresearched.definition: Web research was unavailable during this check, so nothing was looked up.

facts.title: Your catalog against your live page
facts.description: Compared without AI: what your catalog says against the structured data agents read on your product page.

assistants.none: No assistant answered during this check.

changeIf.title: What would change this verdict
changeIf.verified: A page outside your store disputing it, or this claim changing in your listing.
changeIf.cited: ecentic finding the claim on the cited page itself, or on another independent page.
changeIf.contradicted: {host} correcting itself, or your listing changing to match it.
changeIf.notCheckable: Restating it as something measurable: a number, a named test or a named comparison.
changeIf.unresearched: Running the check again once web research is available.
changeIf.merchantOnly: A review, retailer listing or test report beyond your store and brand that states the {attribute}.

fix.title: What to do
fix.verified: Keep it. Cite or link the source on your product page so assistants find the evidence next to the claim.
fix.cited: Make sure the evidence for this claim is also on your own page, in words an assistant can quote.
fix.contradicted: Check "{span}" against {host}. If your listing is right, publish the evidence; if not, correct it.
fix.notCheckable: Replace "{span}" with a measurable statement — a number, a named test or a named comparison — or remove it.
fix.merchantOnlySpec: State the test conditions or standard behind "{span}", and link a datasheet or third-party test.
fix.merchantOnlyCertification: Name the certifying body and certificate number for "{span}", and link the certificate.
fix.merchantOnlyComparative: Say what "{span}" is compared against, and cite a dated benchmark.
fix.merchantOnlyOrigin: Back "{span}" with something checkable: the manufacturer, the facility, or a certificate of origin.
fix.merchantOnlyPolicy: Publish the policy behind "{span}" on its own page and link it from the listing.
fix.merchantOnlyOther: Back "{span}" with a source an assistant can check, and link it from the listing.

claims.divergenceFix: {assistants} state a different {attribute}. Put the correct value in your product's structured data so assistants can read it from you.

details.brandNote: Any site other than your store counts as external, except one named after the brand, which is treated as the brand's own. External is not the same as impartial.
